orespawn_integrations.deed.missed_truco: Ah, you missed truco. Sit down, I'll tell it.
orespawn_integrations.truco.pattern: TRUCO! New one took a frying pan to the dark wood. Last week a stick. Next week, a spoon.
orespawn_integrations.deed.reading.first: Item: one Hatchling, assorted. Punched a tree. Kept the egg.
orespawn_integrations.deed.true_causo.to: ...It really WAS a frying pan? Then there's no fun telling it.
orespawn_integrations.deed.yard_casket: Somebody's casket turned into an ipê in %s's yard.
orespawn_integrations.deed.market: The market came to %s's place. Word is it was the craftsmanship.
orespawn_integrations.deed.homestead: A stray turned up at %s's place and stayed.
orespawn_integrations.deed.hamlet.2: The neighbours already complain about the quero-quero.
orespawn_integrations.deed.parish: %s's house is a parish now. It even has an Odete.
orespawn_integrations.deed.town.2: The bell rings at noon and nobody knows who pays for it.
orespawn_integrations.deed.manor_600: Six hundred standing at %s's. Seu Zé says it's all Hoard furniture.
orespawn_integrations.deed.canopy_hat: %s shook a tree and a hat fell out. Says it was the Queen's.
orespawn_integrations.deed.canopy_egg_pa: %s punched a tree and a piece of King fell out. About a ninth.
orespawn_integrations.deed.mimic: The casket that fell out of the tree bit %1$s. %1$s bit back.
orespawn_integrations.deed.wrong_tree: %s chopped the wrong tree. The tree chopped back.
orespawn_integrations.deed.boss_first: %1$s was the first to bring down %2$s, with %3$s.

orespawn_integrations.hunt.obituary: OBITUARY: %s, %s. Brought down by %s on day %s. The family asks for no flowers, only loot.
orespawn_integrations.hunt.caption.craig: A goat. Yes, a goat. Don't.
orespawn_integrations.hunt.caption.proct: Exam proctor. Bring the key, hand in the paper.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.livro: Who are the lords that never bow?
Kings and gods of eaten worlds, whose forges rival the royal smiths.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.speaker: Captain Iracema: %s
orespawn_integrations.iracema.npc.name: Captain Iracema
orespawn_integrations.iracema.npc.title: Master of the Royal Hunt
orespawn_integrations.iracema.row_above: This one's above your pay grade. Pays triple. Don't make me fetch your body.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.row_below: Easy money. Don't get careless; that's how easy money goes.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.r2: A Hatchling, right? Your file says 'eggs, assorted, 1 lot'.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.r2.2: %s or not, you hunt the same.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.r4: Asleep in a tree in Utopia, him and her. Don't wake them: no bounty pays for that.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.r5: More treasure fell this week. Utopia's vault cracked and it's still dripping.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.unbowed: This one never knelt, not even to the King. They ate his world; he stayed.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.sunday: Not on Sunday. The woods rest. So do I.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.full_moon: Not on a full moon. I mean it.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.royal_bloo: (She bows.) Highness. The bounties pay the same.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.knight: A %s now, is it? Hang up the sword, have a coffee and read the Notice.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.no_tent: No tent nearby. The Captain's board is right here, at the desk.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.desk_copy: A certified copy of the Captain's board. The original's out in the bush.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.jade.table: The Hunt's board: sneak and use.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.dialog.gre: Bounties on Monday, proofs any day. Place, target, price. What is it?
orespawn_integrations.iracema.dialog.boa: The board's in your chat. Place, target, price.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.dialog.wor: Standing jobs. Take one, finish it, come back.
orespawn_integrations.iracema.board.mark: Bounty done: %s. Collect at the board.
orespawn_integrations.quest.701.title: Hunt: Mobzilla
orespawn_integrations.quest.701.text:
The ground will not stop shaking, and whole forests are going missing overnight. The old-timers call the beast Mobzilla; the bestiary calls it Godzilla. Either way, it has to die.

Track it down and slay it.
orespawn_integrations.quest.701.complete: You actually killed it. The tremors have stopped. Take Big Bertha - you have more than earned her.
orespawn_integrations.quest.702.title: Miner's Fortune
orespawn_integrations.quest.702.text:
Uranium veins glow faintly in the deep dark, and nine nuggets will fetch a fine price - if the mining dimension does not fetch you first.

Gather 9 Uranium Nuggets.
orespawn_integrations.quest.702.complete: Nine nuggets, still warm. Here - a Tiger's Eye Pickaxe, so the next haul comes up faster.
orespawn_integrations.quest.703.title: Tea with the Queen
orespawn_integrations.quest.703.text:
The Queen does not take visitors, and her dragons do not take prisoners. An invitation to tea, then, delivered at sword-point.

Slay The Queen.
orespawn_integrations.quest.703.complete: Regicide, and before the kettle even boiled. The Royal Guardian Sword is yours by right of conquest.
orespawn_integrations.quest.704.title: The Trials
orespawn_integrations.quest.704.text:
Word from the deep dark: chambers of copper and tuff, built for one purpose - testing whoever walks in. The locals call them trial chambers. I call them a job interview.

Best a trial spawner's gauntlet and deliver the Trial Key it surrenders.
orespawn_integrations.quest.704.complete: A genuine Trial Key. So the chambers found you worthy - or careless enough to look it. Emeralds, as promised, and a little something ominous for your next visit.
orespawn_integrations.quest.705.title: Vault Heist
orespawn_integrations.quest.705.text:
Two vaults, two keys. Somewhere out there is a key stamped with Mobzilla's likeness, and another that reeks of the Kraken's lair. I don't need them - I need to know they can be found.

Bring me both vault keys to see. Keep them; whatever waits behind those doors is yours.
orespawn_integrations.quest.705.complete: So they're real. Mobzilla's vault and the Kraken's hoard, waiting on the pair of keys you carry. Take these diamonds - and whatever you find in there, don't tell me what it cost.
orespawn_integrations.quest.706.title: Enchanter of Legend
orespawn_integrations.quest.706.text:
The old enchanters bound a dragon's breath and a kraken's grip into common books - a lost art, they say. Uranium was the catalyst; a bound book, the vessel.

Deliver one enchanted book and eight uranium nuggets, and I'll show you what legends are made of.
orespawn_integrations.quest.706.complete: A vessel and a catalyst. Give me time and a lead-lined room, and we'll see about those lost enchantments. Rubies for your trouble - four, cut from the Queen's own hills.
orespawn_integrations.quest.701.option.2: That thing will eat me alive.
orespawn_integrations.quest.701.dialog.t:
You picked a bad stretch of land to settle, {player}. Ore that glows, ants the size of barns, and something big enough to flatten a mountain ridge when it rolls over in its sleep.

I hunt the things OreSpawn drags in. If you have the spine for it, start with the big one - the locals call it Mobzilla. And when you are done, ask me about uranium, or about paying the Queen a visit.
orespawn_integrations.quest.701.offer: Mobzilla. Big as a hill, slow to anger. Bring it down.
orespawn_integrations.quest.702.offer: Nine uranium nuggets from the deep mines. Mind the glow.
orespawn_integrations.quest.703.offer: The Queen. Her tree, her dragons, her tea. Pays well.
orespawn_integrations.hunt_lodge.op.refu: Hunt Lodge not placed: part of its footprint isn't loaded. Stand closer.
orespawn_integrations.hunt_lodge.op.plac: Hunt Lodge placed. Captain Iracema is at her board.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.gift.d: That diamond's home again. The King still owes the Land about three hundred thousand.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.gift.t: That's home again. The King still owes the Land about three hundred thousand.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.scrap: That scrap's from the King's book. Tore lengthwise, see? So nothing's where it belongs.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.except: Everything's out of place, friend. Except the Land.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.notebo: This notebook is the Land's. The King took the magic; the handwriting stayed.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.diamon: That diamond's home again. If the night gets rough, throw it in a flower-ringed pond.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.time_l: A clock doctor? The King swallowed a whole clock. Its angels still guess where things go.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.gift.c: That's not for smoking, friend. It's an offering: the Curupira likes them.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.sticke: The King ate ninety-four. Ninety-five is the Land, and nobody swallows that one.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.origin: Well now, what sort of thing are you? Never mind. Take it.
You're the Land's own. This one isn't a refund, it's a present.
Even the dead get their change back. Took its time, that's all.
The King's kin, refunding the Land. Life's funny like that.
Don't go selling that. A refund isn't stock.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.grotto: Ate the Mestre's diamond. Running from the refund.
chat.orespawn_integrations.mestre.runawa: A runaway diamond. The Court accepts it.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.wonde: An old man gave you a diamond and said the King still owes the Land.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.livro: Why does the Mestre give things away?
Every gift is a refund of what the King took.
Why do the Angels throw people across worlds?
They guard the broken Royal Clock and guess where things belong.
